inlines.v: FRA'GRANCE, 'GRANCY, noun [Latin fragrantia, from fragro, to smell strong.] Sweetness of smell; that quality of bodies which affects the olfactory nerves with an agreeable sensation; pleasing scent; grateful odor. Eve separate he spies, vailed in a cloud of fragrance - The goblet crown'd, breathed aromatic fragrances around.
